title: Fourier form of the noise kernel
statement:
For every natural number $n$, every real number $\rho$ and all points $x, y$ of the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$,
\[
  \sum_{S \subseteq [n]} \rho^{\abs{S}}\,\chi_S(x)\,\chi_S(y)
  \;=\; \prod_{i=1}^{n} \bigl(1 + \rho\,\sigma(x_i)\,\sigma(y_i)\bigr),
\]
where the sum ranges over all subsets $S$ of $[n]=\{1,\dots,n\}$, $\chi_S$ is the
Walsh--Fourier character indexed by $S$, and $\sigma$ is the sign encoding sending
$0\mapsto 1$ and $1\mapsto -1$.
hypotheses_covered: ρ is an arbitrary real number
x and y are points of the n-dimensional Boolean hypercube
